sources.title: MARICL — Multi-Agent Residual In-Context Learning - GitHub
sources.snippet: We introduce Multi-Agent Residual In-Context Learning (MARICL), an agentic framework in which LLM agents analyze where a base model fails, hypothesize missing structure from high-residual examples provided in context, and produce explicit correction terms refined through multi-turn textual gradient optimization.
